patterns: APPSC asks state 'firsts': Tamil Nadu = compulsory rooftop rainwater harvesting; Meghalaya = first draft State Water Policy.
Body/year one-liners: NWDA (1982), NWRC chaired by PM, National Water Policy editions 1987/2002/2012.
Traditional water-harvesting terms (e.g., Korambu of Kerala) appear in APPSC G1.
App adds AP projects (Pattiseema, Polavaram, Godavari-Cauvery links) and CADWM data; PYQs are mostly direct identification.
